body.zh: 从学习目标倒推：先想好怎么检验学会了，再设计课堂活动。
body.en: Design backwards: decide how you’ll check learning, then plan the activities.

prompt.zh: 帮我备一节课，先确认学段、目标和学情。
prompt.en: Help me plan a lesson, starting with the class, goals and learners.

body.zh: 按基础、提高、拓展三层出题，附答案和评分要点。
body.en: Create tiered questions — core, stretch, challenge — with answers and marking points.

prompt.zh: 帮我出一套基础、提高、拓展分层练习。
prompt.en: Help me create basic, intermediate and extension exercises.

body.zh: 导入、新授、练习、小结，生成一节课的课件和讲稿。
body.en: Generate slides and speaker notes for one lesson: hook, teaching, practice, wrap-up.
